title: vosu.status
description: Best-effort, declared common namespace (ADR 0020): the session's coarse game status. Capability id: field:vosu.status(.<path>).

status.description: Coarse status common to rhythm games. `null` only if the plugin's manifest does not declare `field:vosu.status` for this field. A game whose client has no equivalent to one state maps to the nearest listed value rather than inventing a new one.
